---
description: List the macrift Claude Code toolkit — agents, commands, rules, hooks, env, statusline, MCP installed in ~/.claude
---

Run `bash $HOME/.claude/macrift-toolkit.sh` and show its output verbatim to the user.

It's a read-only catalog of what macrift installed (the complement to `/doctor`, which checks health). If the script is missing, tell the user to run `macrift → Claude Code → Setup` (the Doctor component installs it).
